prompt: Complete buildToolbar so the panel uses a LEFT aligned FlowLayout with an 8 pixel horizontal gap and a 4 pixel vertical gap, holding the Cut, Copy and Paste buttons in that order.
explanation: A JPanel already has a FlowLayout, but the default one is centred with 5 pixel gaps, so you have to install your own FlowLayout(align, hgap, vgap) to control those. FlowLayout places components in the order they were added, which is why the sequence of add calls is part of the specification rather than an implementation detail. Alignment only becomes visible when the row is narrower than the panel: LEFT pushes the buttons against the left edge instead of centring them.
hints: setLayout(new FlowLayout(...)) must come before or after the adds -- but the three-argument constructor is the one you need.
FlowLayout.LEFT is the alignment constant; the second and third constructor arguments are hgap then vgap.
Add the buttons in the same order the tests expect: cut, copy, paste.
